messages.text: Fery handed nightmare opener at US Open as top stars learn opponents

metadata.summary: Carlos Alcaraz and Novak Djokovic are on for a US Open collision course following Thursday's draw in New York, while Britain's Arthur Fery has been handed a nightmare opening-round clash against Italian 13th seed Lorenzo Musetti.
metadata.content: US Open draw: Carlos Alcaraz, Novak Djokovic, Arthur Fery, Aryna Sabalenka and Coco Gauff find out first-round opponents in New York | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to content US Open draw: Carlos Alcaraz, Novak Djokovic, Arthur Fery, Aryna Sabalenka and Coco Gauff find out first-round opponents in New York Carlos Alcaraz and Novak Djokovic in the same half of the US Open draw as Britain's Arthur Fery is handed a nightmare opening clash; watch the US Open from August 30 live on Sky Sports Tennis and Sky Sports+, streaming service NOW and the Sky Sports app By Raz Mirza at Flushing Meadows, New York Thursday 27 August 2026 18:24, UK Image: Carlos Alcaraz, British hope Arthur Fery and Aryna Sabalenka were all in the draw for the US Open Carlos Alcaraz and Novak Djokovic are on for a US Open collision course following Thursday's draw in New York, while Britain's Arthur Fery has been handed a nightmare opening-round clash against Italian 13th seed Lorenzo Musetti. Defending champion Alcaraz will open his campaign against Roman Safiullin with a potential semi-final meeting with history-chasing Djokovic. It will be the Spaniard's first appearance since recovering from a right wrist injury sustained in April. Djokovic, chasing an elusive 25th Grand Slam title, will face against Argentina's world No 48 Mariano Navone in the first round with the winner to face Matteo Berrettini or Stan Wawrinka, who is playing in his final Grand Slam before retiring. messages.text: York Knights takeover by new local group revealed

metadata.summary: York Knights have confirmed that a "locally-based ownership group" has agreed to take over a majority share of the club.
metadata.content: York Knights: Local ownership group led by David Dickson agree to buy majority share of Super League club | Rugby League News | Sky Sports Skip to content York Knights: Local ownership group led by David Dickson agree to buy majority share of Super League club New local ownership group agree to buy majority share of club; Outgoing chairman and chief executive Clint Goodchild believes "the club is in safe hands and has a very bright future" Thursday 27 August 2026 17:39, UK Image: York's LNER Community Stadium York Knights have confirmed that a "locally-based ownership group" has agreed to take over a majority share of the club. The group is headed by York businessman David Dickson and his family with the transfer of ownership for both York Knights and York Valkyrie currently progressing and pending formal approval by the Rugby Football League. York Knights won promotion to Super League for the first time at the end of last season and are 12th in the table. messages.text: Arsenal to face Real Madrid as City and Villa get PSG in CL league phase

metadata.summary: Last season's European finalists Arsenal will play Real Madrid and Bayern Munich in this year's Champions League league phase.
metadata.content: Champions League draw: Arsenal to face Real Madrid and Bayern Munich in league phase as Man City and Aston Villa get PSG | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Breaking Champions League draw: Arsenal to face Real Madrid and Bayern Munich in league phase as Man City and Aston Villa get PSG Arsenal will play both Real Madrid and Bayern Munich in the league phase of this season's Champions League; Liverpool will travel to Inter Milan, while both Man City and Aston Villa will host holders PSG; the first round of games will be played September 8-10 Thursday 27 August 2026 18:19, UK Last season's European finalists Arsenal will play Real Madrid and Bayern Munich in this year's Champions League league phase. The Premier League champions will also face Borussia Dortmund and Napoli in their bid to finish in the top eight automatic places, having topped qualifying with a perfect record last term. Meanwhile, both Man City and Aston Villa will host holders PSG. The Villa Park fixture will be a repeat of the recent Super Cup, which PSG won 2-1 in Salzburg . Among Liverpool's fixtures is a trip to Inter Milan and another tie against Atletico Madrid, with Man Utd also scheduled to face Diego Simeone's side. metadata.content: Rangers transfer news: Minsu Kim joins from Girona as Ibrox club's 12th summer signing | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Transfer Rangers transfer news: Minsu Kim joins from Girona as Ibrox club's 12th summer signing South Korean international Minsu Kim has signed an initial four-year deal at Rangers with the option of a further 12 months; the winger scored six goals while on loan at Andorra in Spain's second-tier last season; the Scottish Premiership transfer window closes on September 3 at 5pm Sahil Jaidka Scotland Bureau Editor @SahilJaidka Thursday 27 August 2026 13:04, UK Image: Minsu Kim is Rangers' 12th summer signing Rangers have signed winger Minsu Kim in an £8.5m deal from Spanish side Girona. The 20-year-old has put pen to paper on an initial four-year contract, with the option of a further 12 months. Kim is Rangers' 12th summer signing, with striker Kevin Kelsy expected to follow after the Ibrox side agreed a £9.2m deal with his club, Portland Timbers , ahead of the transfer deadline on September 3. messages.text: 'London or Madrid' - Alvarez's Arsenal ultimatum explained

metadata.summary: Atletico Madrid say they will not enter into negotiations with Barcelona for striker Julian Alvarez, who is considering a move to Arsenal.
metadata.content: Julian Alvarez transfer news: Atletico Madrid won't sell striker to Barcelona with Arsenal the only option | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Transfer Julian Alvarez transfer news: Atletico Madrid won't sell striker to Barcelona with Arsenal the only option Julian Alvarez has two options: stay at Atletico Madrid or move to Arsenal; Atletico say they won't enter negotiations with Barcelona; Alvarez wanted a move to their LaLiga rivals but is now considering a switch to Arsenal; Premier League champions believe signing Alvarez is very unlikely Thursday 27 August 2026 13:41, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Sky Sports' Rob Dorsett gives an update on the Julian Alvarez transfer saga, and questions whether tensions between Barcelona and Atletico Madrid could benefit Arsenal in their potential move for the Argentine striker Atletico Madrid say they will not enter into negotiations with Barcelona for striker Julian Alvarez, who is considering a move to Arsenal. Alvarez did not train on Wednesday and Thursday because of illness after a poor night's sleep on Tuesday, not because of anything related to his future. The 26-year-old wants to join Barcelona , who again went public with their desire to sign him on Wednesday in an interview with president Joan Laporta.
